code_admission: Verified tenant/Product/Project/repository, code actor authority and initial flow approval. S01 reads the repository design and records readiness gaps; no environment connection is required for code-only work.
runtime_binding_handoff: Coordinator resolves actual launch bindings and authority while code work runs. An accepted flow uses a native plan amendment preserving progress; unresolved operations remain blocked. Code approval does not grant environment access.

provider_evidence_handoff.selection: protected seven-provider revisions must agree with private manifest and independent Profile/provider readbacks
provider_evidence_handoff.pilot: require all 46 pre-closure criteria, including five S14 supplements, plus matching native and independent provider receipts
provider_evidence_handoff.closure: recheck every current provider revision before protected finalization; original 44 mapped rows retained
provider_evidence_handoff.live_followup: SCN-06 GitLab/SaaS consent, qualification, ownership and cleanup require coordinator/operator admission

initial_owner_decisions: pilot scope and actual component/acceptance owners
provider consents and actual source targets
delegated independent recommendation review against frozen rubric
owned-resource removal on completion/failure/abort/expiry; exact retention holds
finite spend, retries, wall-clock, runner window and cloud load
admission_checks: only registration acceptance gate; all evals machine; ORCHESTRATION_AUTONOMY_GATE_EVERY_WAVE disabled
registered repository installation and delegated actions admitted
branch/environment protections admit the actual automated actors; no bypass
gateway, worker and scheduler have protected operations and durable continuation enabled
future workflow definition resolved from verified predecessor, not a guessed future SHA
existing runner pool supports four-hour measurement jobs capped at 300 minutes, fresh job credentials and >=56-hour workflow/execution/authority window; expiry has >=56 hours left
finalizer authority and external ledger/schedule survive stopped worker and disabled feature
automatic_implementation_checks: S09 CI checks every accepted repair path, including workflow-only repairs
S07 runner/CI/permission preflight precedes mutation; actual operations repair/resume proof runs on owned fixtures inside the admitted campaign before its timed soak/acceptance
S11 field inventory is derived from verified implementation automatically
S07 completion consumer only closes matching accepted requirements after final machine verdict
exception_policy: Stop affected action and finalize owned resources on revoked authority, out-of-scope changes, exhausted limits or failed recovery. Report an explicit blocked/failed outcome; never pass or silently expand scope.
future_definition_rule: The fixed definition_revision is an authoring baseline. Each operations binding has definition_predecessor; the engine resolves the reviewed future workflow definition from that receipt without a mid-run policy amendment.
registration_status: initial approval recorded; runtime bindings outstanding; see private flow receipts for execution status
